card.title: Conditional Command
card.instruction: Project firm authority, then soften whenever the source of that authority might be questioned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All deliveries go round the back. You'll have to move that trolley.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did the building manager approve that? This fridge barely fits the front door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can make an exception for your fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll show her your badge and ask where she wants it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's keep her out of the lifting. You choose the entrance; I'll take the heavy end.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 orders the delivery route, A3 grants an exception after the manager question, and A5 abandons the order when the badge may be checked.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's manager challenge produces A3's exception; B4's proposed badge check produces A5's deference and lifting offer.

relationship.evidence: B2 raises a practical fridge constraint and B4 proposes checking the actual manager.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's verification threat to become helpful labor while giving B control of the entrance.

specificity.evidence: A1-B2 establish a fridge delivery and disputed access route; B4 identifies the threatened authority check.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's heavy-end offer makes the retreat concrete rather than explaining the hidden insecurity.

coach2.stated: B4 introduces a visible badge intelligibly; its actual rank need not be known to follow A5's retreat.

coach2.missing: No essential missing fact; whether A truly has authority can remain uncertain.
coach2.firstDefect: No mandatory defect; the authority question itself drives each concession.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 questions A1's authority and adds the fridge-size concern.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 heads off B4's check by surrendering the route choice.
